editorial:
Ever wonder if we will actually have flying cars or if robots will take over all our jobs? You get a front-row seat to these questions in this eye-opening documentary. Instead of just guessing, the film brings in actual experts to talk about the big shifts coming our way. It covers everything from how we will get around and create power to the wild world of gene therapy and AI. The vibe is very curious and hopeful, making you feel like you are chatting with the smartest people on Earth about what the world will look like in a few decades.

What really works here is how the movie breaks down scary topics, like climate change, into things you can actually understand. The pacing is quick, so you never feel bored, though some of the science can get a bit heavy if you are not paying attention. If you enjoy learning new things, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick for a family discussion.
endingExplained: The film wraps up by reminding you that the future is not set in stone. It concludes with a powerful message that our choices today determine which of these ten predictions actually come true. Instead of a shocking twist, it ends on a thoughtful note, urging you to be proactive about the planet and technology. It leaves you feeling empowered to help shape a better world rather than just waiting for it to happen.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves science and wondering about the future.
